cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: I Know How to Fix Us
cards.instruction: Perform confidence about repairing the relationship while improvising every step.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We can fix last night's shouting. Tea first, then one honest sentence each.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I don't want tea. I want you to listen without interrupting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. Listening stage. I'll write down anything I want to interrupt with.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You'll be writing instead of listening.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you keep the pen. Supervised listening. If I interrupt, write it down; we'll start with that.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 confidently sets repair steps; A3 invents a listening stage; A5 invents supervision while ceding the pen to keep B engaged.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 wants uninterrupted attention, causing A3 notes; B4 identifies their attention cost, causing A5 B-held monitoring.

relationship.evidence: B2/B4 consistently pursues being heard and changes A method twice.

heightening.evidence: A5 converts any interruption into the material for the first repair topic under B observation.

specificity.evidence: A1 last-night shouting establishes stakes; A3/A5 pen role is proposed explicitly and remains coherent.

brevityWit.evidence: A1 and A3 lose the detachable voluntary/in-charge phrases; every remaining sentence proposes or revises a usable conversational action.

coach2.stated: A1 repair after shouting; B2 objects to interruptions; A3 proposes A writing; A5 transfers that monitoring task to B.
coach2.inferred: The repair process is invented in response to B, not an established protocol.
coach2.firstDefect: Flagged A3 status insertion removed without losing the actual adaptive authority.
